notes.dedupe: The store carried NO Sao Paulo products at all, so nothing could be a duplicate.
notes.seasonReading: Sao Paulo is Brasileirao, so the store convention of a single calendar year applies, as it does for Inter Miami. SUPERBET with New Balance dates the current pair to 2025. The two MOTOROLA shirts are Penalty-era and cannot be pinned to a year from the garment, so they carry the sponsor instead.

garments.title: 2025 Sao Paulo Home Fan Version
garments.blurb: Red, white and black striped home shirt with a cream collar and the SUPERBET sponsor.
